name: Beam Grid Hero
summary: An infra-style hero with a drifting grid, light beams that burst into particles on a framed terminal, a blur-rise headline and a copyable install pill.
useWhen: A developer tool, CLI or infrastructure product needs an opening section that shows a real command
The hero should feel alive without video, using only CSS and motion
avoidWhen: The brand is editorial or consumer-facing and needs a full-screen cinematic opening; use `hero-page/prism-hero` instead
The terminal content is long or interactive, because it only types one command and prints a few lines
source: Original; idea from infra-product landing pages
